newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's September electrical output up 3.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's September electrical output up 3.77 pct.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in September rose 3.77 percent to 1,353 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Wednesday.
Electrical power output in the first nine months of the year was up 2.39 percent to 12,210 GWh, compared with the same period last year, according to a ministry report.
Public service firms produced 1,087 GWh in September while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 266 GWh of the country's total output.
In the first nine months, public service firms produced 9,729 GWh, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 2,481 GWh.

State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power-generating public service firms, produced 505 GWh in September, down 9.27 percent compared with the same month last year. The state company produced 4,763 GWh in the first nine months, off 14.9 percent from the year earlier period.
